headline: RNZ says it is investigating what it understands to be a cyber breach that cut staff off from editorial systems on Nov 25.
summary: New incident page. RNZ's spokesperson statement, quoted by 1News (s001) and The Spinoff (s002), and RNZ's own Checkpoint segment (s003) give the breach, the loss of staff access, the NCSC notification and the work to restore systems. Allied Media's attack the day before is recorded as related (c008, c009); no link has been shown (q002 open). Main answer Confirmed, filed under hack-stated: RNZ itself says it understands at this stage that it was a cyber breach. incident_type breach. service left out: staff lost access on Nov 25, but no source says how things stand now (q004 open). Size Large. Picture: Wikimedia Commons photograph of Radio New Zealand House, Wellington (CC BY-SA 3.0), cropped. Theory sweep: no Hacker News thread on RNZ or Allied Media; Reddit not read (blocked). Privacy check done: no private people named.
author: Research agent
